thesis: KLA is the process-control monopoly-adjacent franchise of semicap: 58% market share, Q3 FY2026 revenue $3.415B (+11% y/y) with $4.01B of trailing FCF (actually reported, unlike most of this group), advanced packaging revenue doubling toward $1.0B in 2026, and a raised >$140B WFE outlook. Its 2030 targets (13-17% revenue CAGR, 40-50% incremental operating leverage) are credible. The issue is the group-wide one: the market cap (~$308B, ~77x trailing FCF) prices those 2030 targets as already delivered, while quantified headwinds (China export controls -$300-350M revenue, -100bps margin from DRAM costs/tariffs) chip at the near term.
catalysts: Q4 FY2026 results (~late July 2026): guidance $3.575B +/- 200M, non-GAAP EPS 9.87 +/- 1.00
Advanced packaging revenue path from $635M (2025) to ~$1.0B (2026) - the fastest-growing line
CY2026 WFE outlook above $140B; 2026 revenue growth raised to high teens
Service revenue compounding (+16% y/y to $775M/quarter) - the recurring floor
2030 investor-day targets (13-17% CAGR) providing a multi-year narrative
risk_factors: Valuation: ~77x trailing FCF / 66x trailing earnings for a cyclical - the group-wide re-rating applies here too
China export controls: management quantifies a $300-350M revenue reduction in calendar 2026 - the only semicap name with the hit already sized
Margin headwinds: elevated DRAM prices and tariffs depressing gross margin ~100bps through at least 2026
